_comment: Merge the PostToolUse array below into your project's .claude/settings.local.json (or global ~/.claude/settings.json). If a `hooks.PostToolUse` array already exists, append these entries to it rather than replacing it. Replace the ABSOLUTE PATH in the context-guard command with the real path to configs/hooks/context-guard.mjs on this machine (Claude Code does not expand ~ or $VARS inside hook commands).

PostToolUse._entry: memory-review-after-commit — nudges an auto-memory review after every git commit

hooks.command: in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE '"command":"[^"]*git commit' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A git commit just completed. Per user preference, review the session since the last memory review and update auto-memory with anything worth saving: non-obvious preferences, workflow, constraints, gotchas. Skip what git history, CLAUDE.md, or the repo already record."}}' || true

PostToolUse._entry: context-guard — injects a wrap-up nudge when the context window fills up
